| role | light | dark | ramp |

| brand | #1F6F8B | #5DB3D0 | tide 700/300 |
| neutral | #5B6770 | #9AA5AD | slate 600/300 |
| background | #F6F8F9 | #0F1A21 | slate 50/950 |

## Rationale

- calm: one cool hue and generous neutrals keep the page quiet.
- exact: one even line weight and dark ink text.
- palette: tide-blue is the only brand hue, chosen for calm; no claim about what blue means.
- type: Inter. One family, body 16 px.

## Story

Tideline is a timeline view for backend engineers who read logs. Raw lines show everything and explain nothing, so it shows what changed.

The mark is one rising wave line in a single tide blue, and the type stays plain so the lines stay readable.
